title: fix correctly identifies and navigates the full SSE data JSON structure
description: The fix matches the actual wire format emitted at events.rs:438-441 exactly: {"changed": {"a-self": batch}} where batch is a HashMap of type_name→state_token. A contributor might suggest 'simplifying' this to parse at a shallower depth or extracting only the inner map. That would be wrong: the outer wrapper follows RFC 8620 §7.1 StateChange object shape (changed key maps account IDs to changed types), and the a-self account ID is the only account this single-user daemon ever has. The three-level navigation is not overengineering; it matches the spec structure. The inline comment documenting the exact JSON shape is also appropriate — without it, the magic string 'a-self' looks like a placeholder.
